description: Search persistent memory by keyword (BM25 full-text). Returns matching memories from the current project and/or personal scope. Call before asking the user about past decisions, conventions, or preferences they may have told you before. Search well: break the question into its concepts and try 2–3 phrasings per concept — synonyms, the user's other language, shorter keyword forms — and check the other scope too, before concluding nothing is stored. Results are ranked by BM25 within review tiers — reviewed (approved/published) project memories come first. `limit` caps how many come back (default 8) and `type` restricts to one memory type.

query.description: Free-text query. File paths, error strings, identifiers work well.

scope.description: Which scope(s) to search. Default: both.

type.description: Restrict to memories of this type. Closed taxonomy — a misspelled type is rejected, never silently empty.

name: memory_search
